title: ASTRIL-MPC: Autonomous Traversal Framework of Articulated Tracked Robots with Language-Guided Neural-Kinematic MPC
abstract: arXiv:2609.13083v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In urban search and rescue, articulated tracked robots (ATRs) must traverse structured but contact-rich environments such as stairwells and cluttered building interiors. Reliable autonomy remains challenging because robot-terrain interaction (RTI) is hybrid and discontinuous, and effective flipper-track coordination is difficult to model analytically. We present ASTRIL-MPC, a language-guided neural kinematics model predictive control (MPC) framework for autonomous traversal. translated_title: ASTRIL-MPC：基于语言引导神经运动学模型预测控制的铰接履带机器人自主穿越框架
translated_abstract: 在城市搜索与救援中，铰接履带机器人（ATR）需要穿越楼梯间和杂乱的建筑内部等结构化但接触丰富的环境。可靠的自主性仍然充满挑战，因为机器人与地形的交互（RTI）是混合且不连续的，而有效的履带-摆臂协调难以通过解析方法建模。我们提出了ASTRIL-MPC，一个用于自主穿越的语言引导神经运动学模型预测控制（MPC）框架。通过学习得到的运动学模型根据高度序列和最近轨迹预测短时域任务状态增量；非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）以多目标代价函数和严格的可行性约束进行规划；大语言模型（LLM）则通过一个具备范围裁剪、速率限制和一致性检查的安全校验接口，对选定的权重和约束边界提出有界的更新。编译后的预测器使完整的控制周期能在100毫秒内完成。在三项穿越（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ASTRIL-MPC框架，将学习的神经运动学模型、非线性模型预测控制与大语言模型的安全化参数调节相结合，实现了铰接履带机器人在楼梯间等接触丰富复杂环境中的实时（单周期小于100毫秒）自主穿越。
en_tdlr: ASTRIL-MPC presents a language-guided neural-kinematic MPC framework that combines a learned kinematics predictor, NMPC planning, and safety-checked LLM-based parameter tuning to achieve real-time (sub-100 ms control cycle) autonomous traversal of articulated tracked robots in contact-rich environments such as stairwells and cluttered interiors.
